protocol.bootstrap: 300 steps × 256 teacher-imitation examples; fixed weights and Adam moments for each architecture
protocol.ppo: 8 env × 96 steps; 4 epochs, batch 128; action std 0.12; auxiliary coefficient 0.20
protocol.evaluation: 12 clean + 12 push episodes, 500 control steps each; failed-before-push has null post-push error

metricDefinitions.updateNorm: mean per-minibatch ||weights_after_Adam - weights_before_Adam||2, after clipping and moment preconditioning
metricDefinitions.postUpdateKl: exact raw-Gaussian KL with fixed std, measured on the same collected states/references after all PPO epochs; not clipped-action KL
metricDefinitions.tokenChangeFraction: fraction of fixed rollout references with at least one quantized scalar changed
metricDefinitions.clipFraction: ratio outside [0.8,1.2], separate from advantage-dependent objective clipping
metricDefinitions.sampleClipFraction: fraction of Gaussian samples clipped for physical actuation; not policy-mean saturation
metricDefinitions.recovery: first tolerance entry, not sustained recovery; non-recovery capped at 380 after push
metricDefinitions.cleanMae: episode-mean tracking MAE conditional on completed episodes; always interpret with survival counts

pairedSeedStudy.randomness: paired PPO rollout/reset/shuffle seeds, not independent model initialization; trajectories can diverge after different actions or terminations
pairedSeedStudy.selection: actor scales 1 and 0.05 declared before these trials, from the earlier exploratory sweep; no selection on these evaluation episodes
pairedSeedStudy.uncertainty: sample standard deviation over three PPO runs conditional on fixed bootstrap; not a confidence interval and not a general token-ranking claim

conclusionsSupported: Total-parameter matching does not match actor parameter count or functional capacity. Actor-parameter matching also changes layer widths.
A raw gradient norm times learning rate is not the actual Adam parameter displacement.
Matched 10/50 budgets and paired PPO seeds permit conditional comparisons; inspect per-run outcomes and survival rather than require a winner.
These are small fixed-bootstrap CartPole experiments. They neither isolate token count causally nor prescribe SONIC production hyperparameters.
